records.label: About ZuiGO
records.name: We Solve Problems by Building Great Software
records.introduction: Founded by Dr. Manisha Thakkar, ZuiGO is a software solutions company built on deep AI expertise, years of industry experience, and a relentless focus on quality.

topics.Our Founder:
ZuiGO was founded by Dr. Manisha Thakkar, who holds a PhD in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. She has published multiple research papers at top-tier AI conferences and brings over 10 years of industry experience building software products across domains.
ZuiGO is a software solutions company. Our goal is simple: solve real problems by building great software. We don't believe in flashy promises. We believe in clean architecture, reliable systems, and software that actually works for the people who use it.
Whether it's a healthcare platform, an AI-powered analytics engine, or a modern SaaS product, we bring the same engineering rigor, testing discipline, and operational care to every system we take on.
topics.Our Values:
Tested, Typed, Locked Down
Automated tests, TypeScript end to end, a strict content-security policy, and sanitised input on every write path — on our own site as much as on yours.
Working Software Every Two Weeks
You see the build running at the end of every sprint, not a status report about it. If a direction is wrong, you find out in a fortnight rather than at handover.
Innovation-Driven
We track what is actually new in AI and infrastructure, and adopt it when it makes a system simpler, faster, or safer to run.
Collaborative
You work with the engineers building your system — shared backlogs, regular demos, and no account layer in between.
